'''''Renspecs''''' was a [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighter]] present at a [[AZ 77 (Venzeiia 2)|salvage yard]] near [[Venzeiia 2 Prime]]. The freighter was to be repaired by a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Poltroon]]'' as it was carrying cargo that was likely illegal. The freighter was destroyed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] fighters, including a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] before it could escape.
